messages:
kevin-solutions: fyi ACME sent the onboarding security questionnaire and a follow-up ask in the call notes. main asks: Okta group -> Redwood role mapping example, a signed audit log bundle for last 90 days (chain-of-custody), and explanation of envelope keys / HSM vs our KMS for private deployments. they also want a runbook for reproducing an incident (playback) for vuln triage.

maria-sec: thanks. i can draft the RBAC mapping and the playbook. quick q: do they want group-to-service-account mapping or group->fine-grained route permissions?

kevin-solutions: they said "role mapping for SRE and App teams" plus an example of least-privilege route rules. keep it concrete.

jonathan-infra: for the signed audit bundle we can produce a time-range export from our audit system and sign with the tenant envelope key. for hosted customers we sign with a service key; for private we can provide a signed tarball that they validate with our public cert. is that acceptable?

priya-sre: adding that our SIEM-forwarding (syslog/HTTPS) sends events in near-real time. do they need the raw event stream or the consolidated audit log?

kevin-solutions: they requested "forensics-ready" logs — both: near real-time to SIEM + a signed archive for legal. also asked how we protect key material during export.

maria-sec: draft reply plan: 1) RBAC mapping example (Okta group -> Redwood role JSON + example SCIM mapping), 2) signed audit-export options (hosted signed-by-service-key, private signed-by-customer-envelope-or-HSM), 3) export workflow including integrity checks and chain-of-custody, 4) incident playback runbook (steps + sample commands), 5) note on CVE triage / dependency patching cadence.

jonathan-infra: i can paste the commands for audit export. sample: 
```bash
# export logs for tenant acme-corp
rictl audit export --tenant acme-corp --start 2025-12-01 --end 2026-02-28 --format ndjson --out acme-20251201-20260228.ndjson
# sign with service key
rictl crypto sign --key /keys/service_signing.pem --in acme-20251201-20260228.ndjson --out acme-signed.tar.gz
```
include sha256 checksums and a detached signature.

maria-sec: for chain-of-custody we include: export manifest (who/what/why), checksum, signature, and a delivery receipt (S3 link + audit event id). for private deployments, if they have HSM we can provide wrapped envelope keys and an attestation statement. mention our KMS integrations: GCP KMS, AWS KMS, and Hashi HSM support.

kevin-solutions: ACME specifically asked about HSM vs KMS: they want to know if we can provision keys into their HSM (customer-controlled) or else do envelope keys where the data key is encrypted by their KMS. what's our clear answer?

jonathan-infra: short answer: yes. for private deployments we support importing and referencing customer HSM-managed keys (PKCS#11 or Cloud HSM). for hosted we offer envelope encryption where data keys are wrapped by a customer-managed KMS (if they enable the customer-key option). note: importing keys into our hosted HSM is not allowed — customer retains control for private. we'll add the diagram.

priya-sre: about playback/runbook — we should provide a sandboxed replay with anonymized data. steps: 1) export signed audit bundle, 2) create ephemeral replay tenant, 3) load events with `rictl audit replay --input acme-signed.ndjson --sandbox --replay-id X`, 4) run monitored test scenarios. include RBAC guardrails so replay cannot call external infra.

maria-sec: good. add a short section on vuln triage: they asked about dependency CVE handling. mention our triage SLA: critical cert within 24h triage, mitigations within 72h or rollback; we maintain a dependency inventory and proactively patch/score. include an example: recently triaged `grpc` CVE-2026-1234 — we patched runtime shim and rolled a canary.

kevin-solutions: can we include a short timeline/cutover example for migrating Okta groups -> Redwood roles? ACME asked for step-by-step to avoid access gaps.

jonathan-infra: propose: 1) create new role definitions in staging, 2) map Okta groups using SCIM to staging role, 3) smoke test with small pilot group, 4) apply to prod during maintenance window, 5) enable audit monitoring and quick rollback mapping. include sample SCIM patch JSON: 
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "add",
      "path": "/roles",
      "value": [{"name":"redwood.sre","permissions":["read:audit","read:routes","exec:ops"]}]
    }
  ]
}
```

maria-sec: one more compliance note: provide their legal team with an attestation letter and a copy of our SOC2 / ISO page. include retention policy (90 days raw, 365 days aggregated, configurable for Dedicated).

kevin-solutions: perfect. action items: maria write draft reply and attach RBAC examples + playbook; jonathan produce signed bundle example + commands + HSM diagram; priya craft replay runbook and guardrails. I'll coordinate with ACME for call next Tue.

maria-sec: i will draft and post here by EOD tomorrow. tagging @audit-bot to generate the cert thumbprint we'll reference. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: cert-thumbprint generated: SHA256:3a:7f:9b:... (stored at s3://redwood-sec/exports/3467800000/thumbprint.txt)

priya-sre: noted. @kevin-solutions please add ACME contact and proposed times in calendar invite.

kevin-solutions: will do. thanks all.
